scientific_integrity: The all-prime-power theorem is proved symbolically from the inner-automorphism reduction, a three-equation centralizer system, an exhaustive diagonal-pattern rank classification, exact finite-field counting, and Burnside averaging. Direct finite-field enumeration is used only as an independent consistency check.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only the three-by-three upper triangular algebra. It does not claim a formula for higher rank. Searches and comparisons cover the closest structural automorphism literature and restricted Borel-orbit literature, but unindexed finite-field orbit counts remain a residual originality risk.
title: Fixed-space spectrum of automorphisms of the three-by-three upper triangular algebra
